design_intent: A clear, shaded, step-free approach with obvious wayfinding and a visible entrance, intended as a design goal.
what_could_exclude_guests: Unclear entrance, unlit approach, sun-exposed waits, hard-to-find drop-off, drainage or surface changes.
future_test_or_review: Walk the approach with disabled guests and advisors once a site exists; review signage and lighting at day and night.
professional_review_required: Accessibility specialist or architect; not a compliance claim
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: Wide, uncluttered paths between host, bar, dining, patio and restrooms, kept clear of queues and stored items.
what_could_exclude_guests: Bar queues blocking the host, tight turns, furniture drift, cords, floor level changes, doors that are heavy.
future_test_or_review: Mock the layout at full size with a mobility-aware reviewer; recheck as furniture is rearranged during service.
professional_review_required: Accessibility specialist or architect; not a compliance claim
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: A mix of table heights, seats with and without arms, bench and communal options, and space left open for wheelchairs and strollers.
what_could_exclude_guests: Only fixed or high seating, communal tables with no open spaces, no choice offered, wheelchair users placed apart.
future_test_or_review: Test seating options with guests of varied needs at a pop-up; staff offer choices rather than assign.
professional_review_required: Accessibility specialist or architect; not a compliance claim
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: One plain-language page with legible type, clear dietary and allergen marks, and heat level shown in words as well as symbols.
what_could_exclude_guests: Small or decorative type, low contrast, dense layout, symbols only, glare on laminate, jargon.
future_test_or_review: Read-aloud and low-vision trials with real guests; ask an accessibility reviewer to check print and screen versions.
professional_review_required: Accessibility specialist or architect; not a compliance claim
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: Warm but sufficient light at the menu, steps and restrooms, with glare controlled and no sudden dark-to-bright transitions.
what_could_exclude_guests: Dim mood lighting that blocks menu reading or lip reading, glare from glass, dark thresholds.
future_test_or_review: Evaluate lighting at the table in day and evening conditions with low-vision reviewers.
professional_review_required: Lighting designer and accessibility specialist; not a compliance claim
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: A room where conversation is possible, with quieter zones and soft surfaces considered as a design aim.
what_could_exclude_guests: Hard, echoing surfaces, brewery and kitchen noise, loud music that blocks conversation and staff communication.
future_test_or_review: Observe noise in a test setting and ask guests; keep a quieter area available and offer it plainly.
professional_review_required: Acoustic consultant and architect; not a compliance claim
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: Restrooms intended to be reachable, spacious and clearly signed, with a layout that works for different bodies and caregivers.
what_could_exclude_guests: Distance, narrow doors, no space to turn, no changing surface, unclear signs, items stored inside.
future_test_or_review: Professional design review before any build; guest feedback and routine cleaning and stocking checks later.
professional_review_required: Architect and accessibility specialist; code review by authority; not a compliance claim
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: Staff ask about access needs naturally, offer options without assumptions, and speak to the guest, not the companion.
what_could_exclude_guests: Assuming needs, rushing, unreachable counters, inconsistent knowledge between staff, service that depends on stairs.
future_test_or_review: Role-play and short staff briefings; collect guest feedback; invite disabled advisors to review service habits.
professional_review_required: Accessibility trainer or advisor; hospitality attorney for legal questions
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: Any digital menu mirrors the printed one, works with screen readers and large text, and is never the only way to order.
what_could_exclude_guests: QR-only access, small tap targets, poor contrast, no phone or signal, a menu that is not read aloud by assistive tools.
future_test_or_review: Test with assistive tools and real users before launch; keep a printed and a spoken option.
professional_review_required: Accessibility specialist and web accessibility reviewer; not a compliance claim
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: Information is never carried by color alone; text and key signs have strong contrast against their backgrounds.
what_could_exclude_guests: Color-only heat or allergen codes, low-contrast text on warm backgrounds, decorative patterns behind words.
future_test_or_review: Check designs in grayscale and with color-vision simulation; review with low-vision guests.
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: Step-free routes, usable bar and table heights, reachable counters and clear space for mobility devices, as design intent only.
what_could_exclude_guests: Steps, narrow gaps, high-only bar seating, heavy doors, patio surfaces that are uneven or loose.
future_test_or_review: Full-size layout trials and guest walk-throughs once a space exists; professional drawing review.
professional_review_required: Accessibility specialist or architect; not a compliance claim
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: Visual ways to get attention and information: written wait updates, visible menus, face-to-face service in good light.
what_could_exclude_guests: Calling names over noise, relying on spoken instructions, poor lighting for lip reading, no written option.
future_test_or_review: Test pagers, written notes and screens with deaf and hard-of-hearing advisors; train staff in simple alternatives.
professional_review_required: Accessibility specialist; deaf and hard-of-hearing advisors
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: Clear high-contrast signs, staff who describe the menu on request, and tactile or large-print aids considered.
what_could_exclude_guests: Unlabeled menus, unreadable signs, moved furniture, unannounced obstacles, no offer to read the menu.
future_test_or_review: Trial large-print and read-aloud service with blind and low-vision advisors; keep paths consistent.
professional_review_required: Accessibility specialist; blind and low-vision advisors
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: A quieter seating option, adjustable noise and light where possible, and honest descriptions of how busy or loud the room can be.
what_could_exclude_guests: Surprise noise, strong smells, flashing lights, crowding, no calm space, no way to leave a busy moment.
future_test_or_review: Ask neurodivergent and sensory-sensitive advisors to review; observe peak periods and adjust.
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED

design_intent: Simple ways to share a need before or during a visit, such as a note ahead, a quiet word at the host, or writing on paper.
what_could_exclude_guests: Guests forced to repeat needs, staff unsure of who to ask, no written channel, language barriers.
future_test_or_review: Practice handoff of guest notes between host, bar and kitchen; review misses in team debriefs.
status: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN INTENT - PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED
